prBody: I corrected the 'Not proven' line on the connection-replacement stop: I re-drove it on the real binary at 14be5104 at 21:48Z. Result: no drain ERROR, the durable released within 0.45 s, the fetch in hand was acknowledged, a post-signal message was not delivered to the stopping process, and the next process handled both messages once each. a56be739's DrainSubscription change rests on the regression tests.
